data.desc: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. is an internally managed REIT that acquires, owns and manages primarily single- tenant properties that are net leased on a long-term basis to companies operating service-oriented or experience-based businesses. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio consisted of 2,580 freestanding net lease properties with a weighted average lease term of 14.2 years and a weighted average unit-level rent coverage ratio of 3.5x. In addition, as of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio was 99.6% leased to tenants operating 727 different concepts across 49 states.
